title: Byzantine-Robust Muon: Resilient Momentum Orthogonalization for Distributed Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13137v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Optimization methods, including the Muon optimizer based on the Linear Minimization Oracle (LMO) and momentum orthogonalization, have shown strong empirical performance in large-scale and distributed learning, yet their robustness to adversarial behavior and data heterogeneity is not well understood. We study these methods within a unified first-order trust-region framework and analyze Muon-based updates with robust aggregation for Byzantine-robust distributed and federated learning. Our analysis does not rely on the i.i.d. assumption and introduces a non-Euclidean notion of heterogeneity consistent with the trust-region geometry. Under this framework, we establish convergence guarantees for both general non-convex and star-convex objectives. translated_title: 拜占庭鲁棒的Muon：面向分布式学习的弹性动量正交化
translated_abstract: 包括基于线性最小化预言机（LMO）和动量正交化的Muon优化器在内的优化方法，在大规模和分布式学习中表现出强大的实证性能，但它们对对抗行为和数据异构性的鲁棒性尚未得到充分理解。我们在统一的一阶信赖域框架内研究这些方法，并分析结合鲁棒聚合的Muon更新，用于拜占庭鲁棒的分布式和联邦学习。我们的分析不依赖独立同分布假设，并引入了与信赖域几何相一致的非欧几里得异构性概念。在该框架下，我们为一般非凸目标和星形凸目标建立了收敛性保证。我们的结果为基于Muon的拜占庭鲁棒优化提供了理论刻画，其加性异构性误差下界与已知的不可能性结果一致，且在显式条件下成立。
tldr: 本文在统一的一阶信赖域框架下为拜占庭鲁棒的Muon优化器建立了不依赖独立同分布假设的收敛性保证，并引入了与信赖域几何相一致的非欧几里得数据异构性概念。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes convergence guarantees for Byzantine-robust Muon optimization within a unified first-order trust-region framework, without relying on the i.i.d. assumption, by introducing a non-Euclidean notion of data heterogeneity consistent with the trust-region geometry.
